newDebate.title: What should we debate?
newDebate.aiNotice: Everything this debate produces — arguments, reviews, scores and the verdict — is generated by AI models, machine-readably marked, and may be inaccurate.
newDebate.freePromise: Every gauge fixed. The question is yours.
newDebate.topicPlaceholder: Type a debatable claim or question…
newDebate.freeIntro: Free runs every debate at fixed settings. Type your question and click Start, or choose Premium to set the gauges yourself.
newDebate.premiumIntro: Choose your risk tier, composition budget tier, and depth, then click Start.
newDebate.riskFreeHint: How much is riding on the answer · fixed by the Free plan
newDebate.riskPremiumHint: How much is riding on the answer · explicit asker selection
newDebate.budgetFreeHint: How much work the composition may spend · fixed by the Free plan
newDebate.budgetPremiumHint: How much work the composition may spend · provisional default, editable
newDebate.treeDepthHint: How far the debate expands when cross-maker review is available
newDebate.steeringPlaceholder:
Prefer primary sources
Surface the strongest counter-case early
newDebate.annotationsHint: Free text · logged verbatim, one per line
newDebate.annotationsPlaceholder: Add a note the run will carry…
newDebate.provenance: Tier source, provenance, and machine as-of are recorded automatically with the run contract.
newDebate.legacyNotice: Depth mode, depth of scrutiny, branching width, concurrency, and max tokens are V2 controls the V3 run contract has no slot for — they are not sent.
newDebate.scrutinyDeepHint: More follow-up rounds on weak points
newDebate.scrutinyExhaustiveHint: Agents keep digging until the tree goes quiet
newDebate.roleOverrides: Role overrides are not user-editable — model role assignment lives in
newDebate.defaultUnavailable: The deployment has no valid riskTier row; Risk tier awaits input.
newDebate.invalidAsOf: As of must be a valid date and time.
newDebate.asOfProvenance: ask time (refreshed when Start is clicked)
